description: Find US listed ETFs by ticker, fund name, or a word from the name. Use this FIRST when the user names a fund loosely, then etf_profile with the ticker it returns. Refuses rather than returning a near match: a refusal says why, and for a fund it means ETFIQ does not publish it. A former ticker (SPLG) answers with the fund it trades as now, and a closed fund with its page and the day it closed. Funds filed with the SEC that do not trade (prediction markets, sports teams) come back in filed, with how many are filed and how many trade, never as results.
name: etf_search
